description: This Java source file defines the main Application class for an Eclipse Hono device registry service. It sets up Spring Boot configuration, deploys Vert.x verticles, and manages health check providers. It is part of the device-registry component and implements service startup and health check registration.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Main application class that extends AbstractBaseApplication to set up the device registry service, deploying verticles and registering health checks.

methods.name: setVerticles
methods.description: Setter method for injecting the list of Verticle instances.

methods.name: setHealthCheckProviders
methods.description: Setter method for injecting the list of HealthCheckProvider instances.

methods.name: deployVerticles
methods.description: Overrides the deployment of verticles, deploying all registered verticles asynchronously.

methods.name: postRegisterServiceVerticles
methods.description: Registers additional health checks after the verticles are registered.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point, starts the Spring Boot application.
